requirements.title: Every package directory has one recorded disposition

evidence.description: scripts/check_boundary_coverage.py parses coverage.md's inventory table (shared scripts/boundary_inventory.py) and compares it against the real agent_utilities/ tree, failing on an unlisted, stale, duplicate, or undecided row. Run against today's tree it correctly finds exactly the 17 known undecided directories (images/, data/, protocols/voice_supply_chain/, and 14 skill-content directories) and nothing else wrong; tests/gates/test_boundary_coverage_gate.py pins that exact evidence plus fixtures for each failure class and a passing case. Wired report-only in .github/workflows/advisory.yml (continue-on-error), not as a blocking pre-commit hook, because it is red against the real tree today.

requirements.remaining: Cannot reach a passing delivery_state while 8 directories stay undecided in coverage.md: images/, data/, protocols/voice_supply_chain/, and 5 skill-content directories under skills/ (agent-utilities-deployment, agent-utilities-development, agent-utilities-evolution, agent-utilities-self-evolution, workflows). The nine graph-os-owned skill-content directories previously listed here (agent-utilities-source-integration, autonomous-contribution, graph-engine-and-modalities, graph-ingestion-and-integration, graph-modeling-and-mutation, graph-orchestration-and-automation, graph-query-and-explanation, graph-research-and-analysis, graph-runtime-and-governance) moved to graph-os and were deleted from AU, dropping their coverage.md rows. This requirement's own text forbids inventing a disposition for the remainder; an owner must rule on each row before the gate can move to the blocking commit-stage hook set.
